message.content: {"reasoning":"The defendant was a school cashier and accountant who used his position to divert public funds to his personal bank account and invest in stocks. This constitutes misuse of his official authority to illegally appropriate public money, which corresponds to the crime of abuse of power (滥用职权) among the provided charge labels.","final_answer":"[罪名]滥用职权<eoa>"}
